mentions.name: Web-based raymarching renderer
mentions.description: A web-based raymarching renderer for creating playful, interactive web experiences. The project is in early development.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a web-based raymarching renderer. I'm hoping to use it to make silly web interactives. It's still early days but it can be found here: https://jesterswilde.dev/rmfw
